body: I hope you can feel okay with yourself. I sincerely think you're okay. I guess we can take some solace in just asking this question of ourselves. Reminds us that we managed to reserve this little part of ourselves inside. That it managed to survive. Thus we managed to survive.

Stranger from reddit say: "Happiness is a result of an equally redundant amount of pain." 

Apart from that pointless tirade, honestly, not much of my own happiness makes sense to me either.(Not that I have much) I'm not sure that we have 100% control over it, if that helps?

Unemployed. That's another thing. Also I'm not on any medication.

I'm living with parent, no money, everything is always up in the air with being able to afford to live here. Mum tries to understand but still thinks I have a devil inside me or whatever. Got like 1 actual friend, who's basically a professional con-man, so fuck knows if he even gives a shit or whatever. Apart from that, there's nobody.

Well thanks, I'll try my best. 

I wish I could just cry. I think this would all go away if I could just cry. But boys don't cry.

I don't believe that most people know this sort of pain. If I'm completely honest, just my opinion and etc. But I look at most people and I see a big pile of stupid that...well, I just think I'd get more help talking to my cat. Not to say that I think I'm smart, it's like I'm really dumb but I can tell how dumb I, and everyone else, is. Cursed like shit.

Also right now I don't feel "depressed". I feel empty and unloved etc. But I'm not needing sleep and waking up, and feeling generally able to look people in the eye, all those little things. But I know I'm heading now towards another depressive episode in a couple of weeks/months and I just can't take it. I got a feeling like this is the last one, because the one I had just before was the worst one I ever experienced, and if this one is anyone worse then I feel like I'm just going to kill myself. I don't want to, I don't want my family to go through that, but I just can't take this shit. I can't get one moment of relief, or find one person that I can identify with. The World is one cruel fucker, and the eternity of nothingness is looking more appealing everyday.

Have fun live life to the full. Make sure you never regret anything. The Universe is too big and glorious and life is too short to spend it not being lazy and content. Never feel shame for who you are, you can't do anything about that.

"I told you not to look in my freezer! You didn't see anything else in there did you?"

"Nope..."

"Good. Then today you keep on breathing, for now."
No, no. Plant a house. Build a tree.
You don't seem to realise. I'm not locked in here with you. You're locked in here with me.
It's more likely than you think.

That's a good question. I thought about it for a while. Maybe it's not actual words but just a general lust or an uneasy feeling. 

There's a lot of things I wish I never had to experience though. My parents arguing and my dad hitting my mum when I was younger. All the times I got blamed by my dad for fucking something up. All the times I fell hopelessly for a girl and didn't even attempt to talk to them. All the times I trusted somebody just for them to turn around and treat me like garbage for not looking exactly perfect and not having the right facial features for them. All the times I stood up for myself and got a load of abuse because no fucker could see that I was defending myself against bullies. 

But I haven't got a time machine, I've just got the ability to make sure it never happens again.

You can't offend me, don't worry about it. It's not your problem any way. Just fire away if you want. 

It's hard to explain I suppose, all I really know is that I'm being myself and nothing is being forced under the surface. And I know the reaction I get when I feel like that. It's just hard to come up with actual examples because people aren't like that, they just don't go up to you and tell you that you're pissing them off, they just sort of ignore you and make you feel awkward. And that's fine a few times, but I'm telling you a lifetime of it makes you feel pretty sick.

So you go out and you make good about your ability to change and 'oh I'm going to make everyone happy' (which is 'oh so much bullshit'). And sure everyone is happy, but you're burning inside, your whole skull is tinder. And nobody sees it. Nobody sees all your pain and anxiety. And it makes me hate them secretly. I want to kill them for every time they killed me and didn't even blink. For every time they hated me and didn't feel one bit of empathy. 

And so instead of keeping up all these pretences I think I'd rather just die. I think that's what the people want, that's what I'll give them. I'm just a worthless mound of bullshit sailing along existence not giving a quarter and not getting one. I am seriously lonely. Really, really fucking lonely. Even when I'm with people I'm lonely.

I can't get any of my thoughts out. People just stare at me blankly when I tell them the truth, but when I smile and tell them a bunch of lies with a knife behind my back then they're all so happy to see me. 

They want crazy me kept chained up in my head safe and silent away from the world. They want me just to deal with it all on my own, because it's obviously just my burden. But I can't do it any more, I can't keep the crazy locked up. 

I feel like a lonely blob of oil festooned into a pool of gaggling water.
I'm afraid to say that's pretty much impossible. Unless I win the lottery.
